propositions: inbound_differ._diff_links_inbound is ADD-only by design; when a link is deleted in Jira, the local ticket retains the dep and the reconciliation is silent
the outbound direction has a removal path via outbound_links._diff_link_removals and delete_issue_link, while inbound has no counterpart removal
apply_inbound_records._inbound_update_apply_links drops any non-add link record at the action check, so even a correct removal differ cannot propagate
the feature requires arbitration between directions using peer state history to distinguish 'link we never pushed' from 'link peer deleted', and managed_refs alone cannot make that distinction
ecosystem tools (Aha, Asana, Workfront, Exalate) handle link-deletion mirroring via opt-in configuration, deferral, or do-not-propagate policies rather than automatic mirroring
